name: Old German Baptist Brethren

facts.value: A Brethren body whose members are baptized believers. Baptism is by trine immersion.

citations.excerpt: The membership of the Old German Baptist Brethren churches comprises baptized believers who have been enrolled as members upon personal profession of faith. Baptism is by trine immersion.
citations.vision_checked: printed page image compared word for word, 2026-10-28

facts.value_before_verify: A Brethren body counted by the US Census with the German Baptist Brethren (Dunkers). Members are baptized believers, and baptism is by trine immersion.

research_notes: Census 1926 Church of the Brethren history records a small withdrawal in 1881 but does not name it in the clean OCR run; ARDA has no description. Start date not sourced; placeholder.
